profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at LinkedIn
profile.summary:
Hey,

I'm Tam! I'm a full-stack engineer on LinkedIn's Recruiter Experience team, where we maintain and develop the Recruiter web application that might have led you here :) I have about 6 years of software engineering experience delivering key features, internal tools, and customer facing products. I've worked with frontends to backends, JavaScript to Java, microservices to monoliths, and am well versed in a variety of software engineering principles. In my free time I love to produce music, DJ, and find new places to go hiking! 

Feel free to connect with me!

Github: https://github.com/mtwynn
Portfolio: https://m-tnguyen.com/

Check out my music! 
https://mynnmusic.com/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Fullstack engineer for the Recruiter Experience team under LinkedIn Talent Solutions. Developing LinkedIn's Recruiter desktop application to ensure recruiters and candidates are matched efficiently, effortlessly, and accessibly.

Notable contributions (chronological, newest to oldest)
----------------------------
Currently: 
LIHA (LinkedIn Hiring Assistant):
- Integrated agentic capabilities with search foundation to source candidates for a multitude of different cases. 
- Wrote guidance, documented, and advised team members on best practice for implementing new search capabilities and debugging.

Highlighted Feature of Interest: 
- Implemented functionality to highlight the value of a particular LinkedIn Premium feature based on a user's intent (seeking jobs, growing network, finding sales leads, hiring talent) if a user had clicked on an upsell related to that feature anywhere on the flagship application. 
- Ran experiments for this feature to understand revenue impact and convey findings to product teams. 

Recruiter Lite Variable Pricing (LinkedIn Business Platform): 
- Onboarded a new experience with a concentrated team of engineers to introduce slab (tiered) pricing for the Recruiter Lite launch in October 2023, handling product subscription checkout flow and admin center management. 
 
Explainable AI (Likelihood of interest):
- Worked with product managers and cross functional teams (AI, Search Foundation) to design and implement a feature on Recruiter Search results that utilized LLMs and data aggregation to surface how likely a candidate would be interested in the recruiter's position for hire, as well as showcasing the facets of their profile which contributed to their likelihood metric. 


Skills: EmberJS, GraphQL, Jest, Java, Rest.li, gRPC, JUnit, SQL, Python, A/B testing and feature ramping, CI/CD pipelining, writing tech docs, code reviews

projects.title: LinkedIn Hiring Assistant (LIHA)
projects.description: At LinkedIn, I worked on one of the core teams developing the LinkedIn Hiring Assistant, or LIHA. I integrated agentic capabilities with our search foundation to source candidates for a multitude of different cases. I proposed and introduced changes to the system to improve the quality of the candidate results being served to recruiters, and tested these at scale with internal tooling. This, in turn, helped generate metrics and A/B test results which drove further product decisions, or lifted north-star metrics we use to gauge feature success and performance. I wrote guidances, documented, and advised team members on best practice for implementing new search capabilities and debugging, and additionally conducted team meetings on a weekly basis to align on key product decisions, assign priority to tickets, and review metrics readouts.

projects.title: Keytrack
projects.description:
Github: https://github.com/mtwynn/KeyTrack-web

Application to fetch Spotify music analysis data, organize it, and display it on a clean UI built with MaterialUI/React. Meant for helping DJs (including myself) build sets and mixes by allowing for sorting, filtering, and analyzing music data directly from their Spotify playlists. Looking to extend this to SoundCloud via their API (so if you're from SoundCloud please connect with me and let's chat!)
